configuration.quantizer: per-vector maxabs, symmetric integers -7 through +7, round-to-nearest ties-to-even
configuration.activation_scale_axis: one scale per row, over input features
configuration.weight_scale_axis: one scale per output column, over input features
configuration.rotation: Q = D H / sqrt(n), D diagonal with independent Rademacher signs, H Sylvester
configuration.aggregation: arithmetic mean over 20 seed-level relative squared errors
configuration.scope: synthetic linear layers; no language model quality, throughput, latency or memory measurements
